answer_quote: **Yes.** The media of the artery is thinned (attenuated) beneath the most advanced (lipid-rich, foam-cell–laden) portion of the atherosclerotic plaque, as evidenced by the visibly reduced thickness of the pink medial layer directly under the yellow plaque compared to the intact medial band on the opposite side of the vessel.
note: 同一血管切片可见斑块下方粉红色中膜层变窄，相较对侧较薄；解释与图像相符。
